# One-pager — AI that adapts to the worker

**What Grupo Ferra got.** A shift assistant that 31 of 38 supervisors use every week. The line-stop report went from 40 minutes to 6. Nobody was trained on the tool; the tool was trained on them.

**How.** Three weeks in the plant with the supervisors. No slides. Each one showed me how he reports a stop; the assistant learned that, in his words. Usage reviewed every week with the operations director.

**What a family company should do first.** Pick the one report everyone hates. Give it to the people who write it, not to IT. Measure minutes, not features.

**The line.** The AI adapts to the worker, not the worker to the AI. That is the difference between automating and amplifying.

Pablo González · Bentley University · VYNMSA, Monterrey
